countScope: 1494 full-discovery tests include the first 50 new methods. The 117 focused tests overlap them. Supplemental fault methods run after full discovery with identical producer and preexisting test bytes; they are not added to the full-discovery count.
limits: Trusted main-thread Linux research interface; no application worker or captured garment route is added.
Numerical completeness, requested stop, metadata as-of publication and actual raw child wait status are independent facts.
Parent hashes surviving regular files without structural, provenance, numerical or physical-path admission. Temporary files never constitute snapshots.
SIGKILL, native blocking, memory exhaustion or an exhausted export allowance may leave no snapshot. No journal or resume protocol is supplied.
CPU/address-space/file-size limits are inherited per process. Group samples/reaped usage do not establish a rigorous aggregate CPU bound.
Parent observation has a separate outer-launcher allowance. Trusted same-group cleanup does not confine arbitrary escaped processes or impose aggregate disk limits on arbitrary writers.
Canonical streaming avoids another whole-document JSON string; snapshot deepcopy and large scalar chunks can still allocate heavily.
Focused and supplemental fixtures are synthetic process/transport witnesses, not a garment trajectory or temporal accuracy acceptance.
nextWork: Prospectively bind unchanged original physical/accuracy criteria to a cached adaptive run, explicit process/export resources and a separately budgeted structural/provenance/whole-prefix numerical audit. Preserve all previous failures; temporal/spatial, source-construction, material/body and application gates remain open.
repairsBeforeExecution: Initial mask-query failure must not introduce an un-restorable new block.
Late parent signals invalidate supervision success while preserving actual worker exit.
Reap draining checks its fixed deadline between children and bounds each pass.
Leader wait status supplements process-list liveness; empty samples do not finish reaping before the leader status exists.
Descendant test readiness uses an explicit pipe instead of a scheduling delay.
Close failures retain actual exit and do not skip subsequent orderly restoration.
Private-directory ownership/modes, exact temporary names and per-file/count/total observations are checked.

retainedReviewerOnlyFailure.scope: Reviewer log parser incorrectly required every unittest success to share its method header line; two existing methods emitted warnings before separate ok lines. Numerical/source evidence was unchanged.
